title: Recovery Bike — Leg Absorption
summary: A genuinely easy 22–35 minute bike session for looser legs, not aerobic training. It can stand alone when the upper-body session is inappropriate.

sessionTargets.description: Use this only when pedalling is symptom-free. Stop rather than pushing through worsening knee or Achilles symptoms.
Legs should feel looser and heart rate should settle near 100–105 bpm; this never replaces a Zone 2 session.

prohibitedAdditions: do not exceed 130 W or 118 bpm during the warm-up

steps.notes: 80–100 W, HR below 105 bpm, cadence 85–90 rpm. Use a light gear, smooth circles and remain seated.
100–115 W, HR 100–110 bpm, cadence 85–95 rpm. No standing and no grinding.
110–125 W, HR 105–115 bpm, cadence 85–95 rpm. Legs should feel looser at the end; back off if they do not.
90–115 W, HR 100–115 bpm and cadence 85–95 rpm. Use 12–15 minutes if fresh, 15–20 if mildly heavy, or 20–25 if noticeably fatigued. Keep pressure very light and breathing easy.
